LiteNetLib 1.3.5 (MIT, see LICENSE.txt), unmodified sources from the `LiteNetLib/` folder of
https://github.com/RevenantX/LiteNetLib/archive/refs/tags/1.3.5.zip
(SHA-256 of the zip: 36714c2faf844713768ad37a234ad3483f53df98caefdc7a38c864d6667adc18).
The 1.x line is used because 2.x needs Unity 2021.2+ (the game is 2020.2). Built into ICS2iOS.dll with the
Unity defines set in mod/ICS2iOS.csproj, and into the co-op test bot without them.
